notes: Hand-curated. Episode numbers come from knowledge and are NOT yet checked against TMDB episode data: numberVerified is false on every episode until the data build confirms each title in its season, rewrites the number to TMDB's and fills airDate/runtimeMin/stillPath. The app shows season + title only while numberVerified is false.

servicesSnapshot = US sub/free providers copied from osse-data details/ on 2026-09-26, minus excludeServices. The app resolves availability from the live catalog first and only falls back to this snapshot. usService/source/inGenreCatalog/usRating/catalogTitle are curation provenance; the app ignores them.
hold: true items are never rendered until the build confirms placement and service. Items with tmdbId null (resolve: "runtime") are hidden until the catalog contains an exact title + year match.

Dropped on purpose: The Bear S2E6 "Fishes" (not a cozy watch), Strange Days (dark, R), Scream Stream off-theme ids 666243, 288055, 985, 7972, 499932. Left out until verified: Brooklyn Nine-Nine "Halloween IV", New Girl "Thanksgiving III", New Girl "Valentine's Day".

Converted v1 themes (curated: false): festival-season, may-the-4th, shark-week-survival, back-to-school, reality-tv-rehab, british-escape. One mixed core row each, items typed from osse-data details/ (movie-{id} / tv-{id}), month windows, teaser 14 days before. 288055 (Star Wars: Tales of the Underworld) is kept only in may-the-4th. oscar-sprint-2025 is retired. scream-stream, holiday-classics and hallmark-heartbreak are replaced by the curated collections above.
version 2 = the four curated collections of version 1 plus the converted v1 themes.
